question: How is the ever-new reality perceived by those of ruined or dissolved mind?
premises: Some have dissolution into their own view
inference: Whether approached by a ruined mind or by dissolution into one's own view, the reality remains ever-new.
uncertainties: sva+mata+layā could mean dissolution of one's own view or absorption in one's own mind
plain_english: Whether by a destroyed mind or by dissolution into one's own view, it remains ever-new.
